sourceChecks.title: Origin and evolution of the genetic code: the universal enigma
sourceChecks.paraphrase: PubMed direct open returned CAPTCHA. Prior receipt was search-only and cannot independently substantiate a positive classification.
sourceChecks.limitations: Review synthesis, not a complete mechanistic reconstruction or experimental resolution.

sourceChecks.title: Effective gene expression prediction from sequence by integrating long-range interactions
sourceChecks.excerpt: How noncoding DNA determines gene expression in different cell types is a major unsolved problem
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Enformer improved DNA-sequence-based expression and variant-effect prediction, used interactions up to 100 kb, and predicted enhancer-promoter interactions.
sourceChecks.limitations: This is an improvement on held-out tasks, not a universal exact grammar across all cell types/stages/conditions; no perfect therapy or cell-fate control demonstrated. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Transgenerational inheritance of behavioral and metabolic effects of paternal exposure to traumatic stress in early postnatal life: evidence in the 4th generation
sourceChecks.excerpt: risk-taking and glucose dysregulation until the fourth generation via males
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A specific paternal early-life trauma mouse model reports depressive-like behaviors to F3 and risk-taking/glucose dysregulation to F4 through males, reproduced in separate breedings.
sourceChecks.limitations: One mouse paradigm and selected phenotypes; does not establish a general mammalian mechanism, specific causal marks sufficient for faithful inheritance, or human preventive medicine. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Small, but surprisingly repetitive genomes: transposon expansion and not polyploidy has driven a doubling in genome size in a metazoan species complex
sourceChecks.excerpt: repetitive element content explained a large portion of genome size variation (at least 54%)
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Four Brachionus species showed seven-fold genome size variation; repetitive elements accounted for at least 54% in analyses and no ploidy change was detected.
sourceChecks.limitations: A single close-relative rotifer complex; does not explain the full 100,000-fold eukaryotic range or resolve organismal complexity correlations. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: A putative de novo evolved gene required for spermatid chromatin condensation in Drosophila melanogaster
sourceChecks.excerpt: subsequent CRISPR-mediated gene deletion revealed that only one of these genes, atlas, was truly essential
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Screened 42 putative de novo genes in D. melanogaster; CRISPR deletion implicated atlas in mature sperm production and spermatid nuclear condensation.
sourceChecks.limitations: A single gene in one species and male reproductive context; not every orphan/de novo gene, full network integration, or crop/antimicrobial impact. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Pairwise and higher order genetic interactions during the evolution of a tRNA
sourceChecks.excerpt: all 87 interactions switched from positive to negative in a substantial proportion of the genetic backgrounds
sourceChecks.paraphrase: In one experimental tRNA system, 87 pairwise interactions were measured across many sequence backgrounds and epistasis changed with genetic context.
sourceChecks.limitations: This is a defined molecular evolution landscape, not all gene-gene and environment interactions or a complete phenotype variance model. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Oncogenic transformation of Drosophila somatic cells induces a functional piRNA pathway
sourceChecks.excerpt: Elements across the entire range of baseline expression levels increased up to 10-fold or more
sourceChecks.paraphrase: In transformed Drosophila somatic WRR-1 cells, silencing Piwi, Armi or Zuc raised transposon expression, in some cases by at least tenfold.
sourceChecks.limitations: A cell-line and piRNA pathway result; does not establish universal genome-wide suppression, meiotic-driver control, long-term stability, or safe large-scale editing. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Evolution of dosage compensation under sexual selection differs between X and Z chromosomes
sourceChecks.excerpt: Our model also predicts that dosage compensation should be most pronounced in genes that are under strong selection
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The paper models differences in X/Z dosage-compensation evolution and tests predictions using chicken transcriptome; support differs by tissue, and age-of-strata prediction was not observed.
sourceChecks.limitations: Does not give complete rules/triggers across independent origins or establish clinical cures, syndrome explanation, or synthetic sex systems. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: A genetic basis for the inviability of hybrids between sibling species of Drosophila
sourceChecks.excerpt: It rescues hybrid males from the cross of D. melanogaster females to males of its three sibling species
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A mapped Hmr mutation rescued otherwise inviable Drosophila hybrids in specified crosses, supporting a complementary-gene incompatibility model.
sourceChecks.limitations: Not nucleotide-resolution causes across multiple lineages, predictive risk control, or conservation/agriculture intervention. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Evolution favors protein mutational robustness in sufficiently large populations
sourceChecks.excerpt: evolution favors protein mutational robustness if the evolving population is sufficiently large
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Laboratory evolution of cytochrome P450 proteins found larger populations tended toward greater mutational robustness and stability under the studied conditions.
sourceChecks.limitations: Protein-level experimental system, not universal genomic principles or validated long-term predictions/design of synthetic organisms. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: A mechanism for the association of amino acids with their codons and the origin of the genetic code
sourceChecks.excerpt: These regularities can be explained if, before the emergence of macromolecules
sourceChecks.paraphrase: The authors propose a prebiotic small-molecule scenario intended to explain code regularities.
sourceChecks.limitations: The abstract presents a hypothesis, not experimental reconstruction of actual primordial code evolution. Independently reopened source snapshot; no live-availability inference.

sourceChecks.title: Origin and evolution of the genetic code: The universal enigma
sourceChecks.excerpt: such scenarios for the code evolution are based on formal schemes whose relevance to the actual primordial evolution is uncertain
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Critical review says formal code-evolution scenarios have uncertain primordial relevance and understanding requires a credible coding-and-translation origin scenario.
sourceChecks.limitations: Review establishes unresolved challenge, not actual primordial history or experimental code-origin proof.

items.corrections: Review says the origin of the code remains mechanistically unresolved and that formal scenarios do not yet connect it credibly to coding/translation. The cited PNAS paper proposes one scenario. The exact prebiotic cause, fixation history, universality mechanism, and orthogonal-code impacts remain unestablished.

Enformer improved gene-expression/variant-effect prediction from DNA sequence and long-range interactions in evaluated tasks. Universal exact predictions for every cell/stage/condition and perfect therapy/cell-fate design are not shown.

A mouse paternal-trauma model reported selected behavioral/metabolic phenotypes through F3/F4. Does not demonstrate a general mammalian heritable-mark system or the asserted human medical/evolutionary impact.

A rotifer species complex showed 7-fold genome-size variation, with repeats explaining at least 54% in that study. Does not explain >100,000-fold variation across eukaryotes or all selective forces and complexity relationships.

A screen of 42 candidate Drosophila de novo genes validated atlas as required for a specific spermatid phenotype. Does not identify or integrate every lineage-specific gene or establish broad species-difference/agriculture/drug impacts.

A tRNA experimental landscape measured pairwise interactions whose sign depended on genetic background. Not a complete genome-wide or gene-environment map, variance accounting, or resolution of unexplained heritability.

A Drosophila somatic-cell study found piRNA pathway knockdown increased expression of multiple transposons. No universal mechanism across taxa/elements or proof of genome-wide prevention, editing safety, or synthetic chromosome safety.

A model plus chicken expression analysis linked some dosage-compensation patterns with selection measures; results varied by tissue. Not complete evolutionary rules for all sex chromosome origins or demonstrated chromosomal cures/synthetic systems.

Drosophila studies map specific hybrid rescue/incompatibility genes and one defined interspecies model. Not exact nucleotide-level incompatibilities across lineages or predictive management of hybridization/speciation collapse.

One laboratory cytochrome P450 evolution study found greater protein robustness in larger populations. Not a universal genomic theory or demonstrated long-term prediction and organism engineering capability.

notes: All ten primary-result URLs were independently reopened and passages matched; code-origin review required new arXiv version because original PubMed blocked and prior receipt was search-only.
Added distinct-URL provenance s17 and removed blocked s6 as positive backing.
All nine narrow experimental/model results remain partial progress; GEN-01 remains an explicitly unresolved goal. No cross-lineage universal mechanisms or forecasts promoted to achievements.
